payload.name: Dormant Recall Pool / 休眠召回池
payload.generated_by: ChatGPT Work Mode assistant; exact runtime model ID not exposed
interaction_rules: Keep at most four versioned behavior capsules; mark at most one active and all other retained capsules dormant.
A new task cue selects only from currently observed capsule metadata; no future task or hidden truth is visible.
A matching dormant capsule pays a restore cost; a miss pays rebuild cost. Every reused capsule is still subject to task validation.
On a task-family switch, export and suspend the active capsule. Retention obeys a separate storage-budget eviction rule.
A capsule carries no reusable external credentials; activation must obtain current scoped authority.
emergent_properties: Separate active compute occupancy from retention duration: a rare capability can survive without remaining a running worker.
payload.nearest_known_baseline: Equal-capacity warm LRU cache; equal-capacity all-cold cache with one transient execution; rebuild-on-demand.
expected_advantages: In sufficiently long recurring phases, lower ongoing active-state cost may outweigh extra restore cost relative to warm LRU.
expected_weaknesses: All-cold plus transient execution may be behaviorally identical.
Stale cues can recall an inappropriate version.
Snapshot and validation costs may dominate.
falsification: Reject the broad superiority claim if an equal-budget conventional baseline ties or dominates across the declared regimes.
Reject the proposed recurring-phase advantage if measured total cost does not fall versus warm LRU under the preregistered recurring workload.
Any correctness gain inferred solely from cost bookkeeping is invalid.
